messages:
liam_support: FYI escalating Katalyst pilot — customer can't finish activation, SSO returns 403 during token exchange. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/98765 :warning:

maria_cs: Thanks Liam. Who's owning primary comms with the customer? Renewal touchpoint is next week; we need a clear comms plan and patch timeline.

liam_support: I'm triaging the 403 now, but we need SE + Eng on standby. Customer says this started after they updated their IdP metadata.

anjali_se: Adding context — Katalyst uses a nonstandard scope `katalyst:session` that we weren't expecting. If token lacks that scope our middleware drops the request. Can share logs.

sam_engineering: If scope is the issue we can relax the validation for the pilot tenant as a stopgap. How many customers affected?

liam_support: Only Katalyst customer A (pilot). They blocked a scheduled demo tomorrow morning.

maria_cs: OK urgent steps: 1) Immediate stopgap so demo can run 2) Root-cause patch 3) Customer comms with ETA and rollback plan 4) Follow-up post-demo: retro + renewal reassurance. Assign owners?

anjali_se: I can do the stopgap validation change and confirm in test tenant. ETA 45m if Eng approves.

sam_engineering: Approve. I'll review a tiny config flag change — prefer feature-flagged on customer-id.

jess_ops: Heads-up: this will touch auth config stored in infra secrets. I need the change request + brief risk assessment to patch in staging and prod.

liam_support: I'll attach support logs and the customer-provided SAML/IdP metadata here: ```RequestID: 0a1b2c3d status=403 token_scopes=[openid,profile] expected=[openid,profile,katalyst:session]```

maria_cs: I'll draft the comms to Katalyst A — we should say we're working on a short-term workaround and propose a 2pm demo window with a follow-up within 24 hours. I'll post draft in this thread.

anjali_se: Change plan: toggle `allow_missing_katalyst_scope` for customer_id=KATALYST-A, validate in staging, then flip prod. No code change, just config + small middleware toggle.

sam_engineering: Sounds safe. Jess, will that require a rotation of any secrets?

jess_ops: No rotation necessary for that toggle, but we need a quick runbook for rollback and a pager contact. I'll create a short RFC in the runbook repo and link it here.

support_bot: Ticket #98765 updated: tag=cs-escalation, priority=high, assignees=[liam_support, anjali_se, sam_engineering].

liam_support: Staging toggle applied and verified with Katalyst test metadata. Demo confirmed for 14:00.

maria_cs: Draft to customer: "We're implementing a targeted config adjustment to allow your updated IdP scope for the pilot tenant and validated it in staging. Your demo is confirmed at 14:00. We'll follow up within 24 hours with a permanent patch plan and a summary of actions." Anyone edit? :eyes:

anjali_se: LGTM. Add note about potential re-authorization if they change metadata again.

sam_engineering: I'll schedule a follow-up PR for a one-line validation improvement to make scopes opt-in per-tenant. Target ETA for permanent fix: 48 hours.

maria_cs: Perfect. Action owners: liam — customer comms + logs; anjali — staging toggle + validation; sam — PR for permanent fix; jess — ops runbook & rollout checklist. I'll own demo coordination and renewal messaging.

liam_support: Sending comms now.

support_bot: Customer message sent to Katalyst A (ref T98765).

liam_support: Customer confirmed demo attendance and said appreciate the fast response.

maria_cs: After demo, let's do a 30-min sync with the customer to review post-demo items and confirm renewal sentiment. I'll schedule for tomorrow.

sam_engineering: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/validation/pull/452 — notes, test, rollback.

anjali_se: Permanent change merged to staging, running e2e.

jess_ops: Runbook created: https://runbook.redwood.ai/ops/allow_katalyst_scope — contains rollback steps and contacts.

liam_support: Closing loop: demo passed. Customer was able to finish activation. Renewal still on the table but they want a short post-pilot performance check.

maria_cs: Great work team. I'll send a post-demo summary and next steps + renewal check-in. Keeping thread open until permanent patch in prod. :thumbsup:
